messages:
maria: Hi all, starting today! Quick orientation Q: I keep hitting permission walls. Can someone point me to the canonical owners for repo access, infra creds, PagerDuty, and who to call if a private deployment account goes sideways? Don’t want to spam multiple teams.
devon: welcome @maria! Shortlist: repo access -> eng-platform, infra creds/KMS -> eng-infra, PagerDuty -> eng-sre, Dedicated customer escalations -> customer-success + solutions-eng.
kevin: For repo perms open a PR-like request in the repo-access queue: https://redwood.internal/permissions -> choose your team and list repos + desired role (read/write/admin). Admin needs manager + security approval; expect ~1 business day.
lea: Infra creds (service accounts, vault tokens) go through infra oncall. If you need interactive access sooner, request a time-limited jump via https://redwood.internal/infra/jump and tag @eng-infra in #help.
ops-bot: [automated] When requesting oncall escalation include: service, env, short symptom, and one command/log snippet. Example:
```
service: redwood-inference-dedicated
env: staging-us-west
symptom: 503s on healthcheck /model/serve
logs: tail -n 100 /var/log/inference/serve.log | sed -n '1,50p'
```
maria: Good call. If I get paged for an incident and it looks infra vs model routing, how do I quickly decide who to page?
devon: Rule of thumb: networking/credentials/storage errors -> eng-infra. High token latency, model mismatches, or KV-cache issues -> eng-runtime. Broad customer impact/outages -> page eng-sre. If in doubt page eng-sre and they will triage.
kevin: For Dedicated (customer) incidents always cc customer-success and the account owner. We have a runbook for Dedicated incidents: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-incident.
lea: Also FYI: we keep a small "escalate@redwood" alias for urgent billing/quota hooks. Finance ops monitors it during business hours.
hr-bot: [automated] New hire checklist reminder: finish security training and submit access requests within 24 hours of start to avoid delays.
maria: Thanks! One last thing: where do we keep the up-to-date who-to-ask matrix so I can bookmark it?
devon: DevEx maintains it on the onboarding wiki; owners are @devon and @lea. Link: https://redwood.internal/devex/who-to-ask. If you find gaps open a quick MR and tag us.
maria: Perfect, I’ll follow up with the repo-access request now. Appreciate the speedy answers :pray:
